episodes.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (colors (grid-colors g -1))
         (selector
           (first
             (sort-by colors
               (lambda (color) (length (find-color g color)))))))
    (build-grid h w (r c)
      (if (any? (lambda (cc) (= (at g r cc) selector)) (range 0 w))
          (at g r (- (- w 1) c))
          (at g r c))))))
